summary: 10 features and 1 fix across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • projectgit: push refreshed snapshot to connected clients (7c685fe)
  • dataaggregation: report Git snapshot freshness in aggregation (f083f9d)

HagiCode-org/web

  • git: read Git snapshot staleness from server (11e6b84)
  • i18n: add conversation message block renderer strings (9523947)
  • conversation: render code, document, and orphan tool-result blocks (1df2660)
  • i18n: add conversation load-earlier strings (557aa91)
  • conversation: virtualize history pane with load-older (627ccd2)
  • signalr: load session history window and older pages (ed87464)
  • store: add history window state and projection listener (72810f6)
  • utils: add conversation message projection utilities (46208f4)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • project-list: let expanded cards fill panel width (00ee571)
